fusions.name: A Mile's Worth
fusions.desc: Sends a blade of wind at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 4% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Road Grit Flung
fusions.desc: Kicks a fan of grit on the wind 4 tiles ahead, which deals 4 damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Easy Stride
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 20 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Paved and Pacing
fusions.desc: On paved ground, you deal 12% more damage. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
